title: Judgment on Moab
description: Because Moab and Seir said, 'The house of Judah is like all other nations,' the Lord proclaims judgment on Moab. He will open up Moab's flank from its border towns—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kirjathaim, the pride of the land—and give the land, along with the Ammonites, to the people of the East as a possession. The Lord will execute judgment on Moab, and they will know that He is the Lord.
